specs.description: Akechi identity: beige/offwhite sleeves and trousers, charcoal armor, BLUE waist sash and skyblue tattered flag. Commander in grey loose haori, simple round black kabuto, sword and black command fan. Archer whiteheadband/quiver. IMPORTANT Akechi gunner also WHITE HEADBAND and tied long black hair, NO conical hat, carries matchlock. Miniboss image4 lean clean-shaven man wearing grey layered haori, black kabuto, blue sash, holds BLACK FOLDING FAN with sheathed katana at waist; NOT naginata. All same correct role costume across eight phases.
specs.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create a NEW faction movement sprite atlas. Image1 is strictly the walking POSE and LAYOUT template: preserve its EXACT wide2:1 canvas, 8columns × 6rows, small figure scale, generous clear transparent gutters, complete weapons and 45px outer margins. Do not enlarge figures or fill blank areas. Images2 onwards define the NEW faction's body armor, faces, clothing, colors, helmets and role-specific weapons, which you must draw faithfully. Render actual changed costume/gear shapes, not a simple recolor. All48 figures face RIGHT. Rows TOPTOBOTTOM: spear soldier, flag bearer, sword commander, bow archer/quiver, matchlock gunner, faction miniboss. Within EACH row, keep the eight-frame walking anatomy from image1: columns1/5 WIDE CONTACT with opposite foot forward, columns2/6 visibly folded airborne trailing calf and bent support knee, columns3/7 NARROW PASSING one thigh lifted high with 90-degree bent knee and one nearly vertical planted leg, columns4/8 airborne heel reach before opposite contact. No frozen repeated wide stance. True alternate left/right feet, actual joint movement and subtle weight shift. Archer/gunner upper body remains facing RIGHT to allow later backwards playback while watching target. No attacks or hurt poses. Every complete figure including flag/weapon must be fully isolated by transparent pixels from EVERY neighbor, no cropped spear tips or bottom feet. Preserve tiny complete characters at the scale of image1, don't maximize detail by making bigger. Genuine transparent RGBA, no groundshadows, boxes, text, labels or scenery. IMPORTANT: new characters must be SMALLER than image1 with more transparent margin, at most70% invisible cell width/height, full 30px blank bands between rows and35px outer border. specs.description: Hashiba identity: worn beige/tan clothes, charcoal lamellar armor with GOLD/OCHRE trim and gold waist ties; broad GOLD YELLOW FLAG. Commander mustached helmeted middleaged samurai with tan haori and fan/katana. Archer whiteheadband, quiver and gourd flask at hip. Gunner whiteheadband and gourd at hip, NOT conical hat, matchlock. Boss image4 sturdy mustached/goateed man in black kabuto, beige sleeves, black armor with yellow trim, short straight YARI spear held across waist, not naginata. Keep weapon complete inside cells.

specs.description: Iga identity: rough grey/beige clothes, charcoal chest armor, BLUEGREY waist sash. Spear soldier conical black hat. Flag bearer WHITE HEADBAND with tied black hair, NO helmet, modest bluegrey flag. Commander black samurai kabuto and dark plated armorskirt, sword and commandfan. Archer whiteheadband, ragged grey robe, quiver. Gunner conicalhat/matchlock. Boss image4 young slender man, black HELMET with long black PONYTAIL projecting from back, ragged beige sleeves, grey pants, bluegrey sash, holds short KUNAI in right hand and a short hanging WEIGHTED CHAIN with iron flail at left hand. Not a sickle and not naginata. Keep chain/weight close body inside every isolated cell.
